name: shardflux
description: Persistent cloud workspaces for AI agents: run commands, servers, builds and a browser in a Linux computer that keeps its files and processes between sessions.

api_key.title: Shardflux API key
api_key.description: A project API key (sfk_...) from https://app.shardflux.dev, under API keys. Its tool permissions decide which workspace tools Claude gets.

default_template.title: Default template
default_template.description: Template for new workspaces when Claude does not name one.
